pages.text: The $(bold)deep split$() of activated crystals: the Activated Fractionator separates an activated crystal into the $(bold)activated component$() of its fuel (7 kinds), with 1 $(bold)exhausted crystal$() as a byproduct.$(br)Crystals are pressed to their purest form here - components are refined materials for further processing.

$(bold)How it works:$()$(li)Input: 1 activated crystal (any of 7)$(li)Process: $(bold)5 seconds$(), costing $(bold)2,000 Akaishi Energy$() per craft$(li)Output: 1 matching activated component + 1 exhausted crystal$(br2)$(bold)Economy:$()the fractionator closes the exhausted-fuel chain - reactor waste ends as two solid crystals after activation, separation and fractionating.
